commentary.text: 90+6' The match has just finished.
90+3' Jan Ziolkowski (AS Roma) sends a long ball across the pitch, but it misses its target.
90' The fourth official shows 5 min. of added time.
88' Jan Ziolkowski (AS Roma) is penalised for holding. Davide Massa signals a set piece.
87' It is time for a substitution. Ignace Van der Brempt (Como) is on for Lucas Da Cunha.
84' What an excellent shot, but not the luckiest one. Lucas Da Cunha (Como) fires the ball from inside the penalty box but it only hits the left post!
79' 2 - 1 Goal 2:1! Diego Carlos (Como) taps home from close range after the rebound fell kindly into his path.

79' Ivan Smolcic (Como) blows a clear opportunity to score a goal. He was one-on-one with Mile Svilar inside the six-yard box and attempted to put the ball low into the middle of the target, but was denied by a great save.
77' Substitution. Nico Paz walks off the pitch and Jesus Rodriguez (Como) comes on as a substitute.
77' Daniele Ghilardi (AS Roma) commits a foul and is shown a yellow card without any hesitation from the referee.
76' What a chance that is! Martin Baturina (Como) finds himself in a promising position after receiving a pass on the edge of the box. His attempt goes just over the bar.
75' Konstantinos Tsimikas (AS Roma) crosses the ball from the free kick, but it goes out of play.
73' Diego Carlos (Como) has to be very careful for the rest of the match after receiving a yellow card from the referee for a bad tackle on an opponent.
73' Lucas Da Cunha (Como) shows off his amazing technique to get to the edge of the box by himself. He pulls the trigger but sends the ball miles of the left post. Nice run, but poor finish!
70' A substitution has been made. Mario Hermoso goes off and Jan Ziolkowski (AS Roma) comes on.
70' Problems for Gian Piero Gasperini as Zeki Celik (AS Roma) is not able to play anymore. His injury is too serious and Konstantinos Tsimikas replaces him.
67' Gian Piero Gasperini has decided to make a change. Robinio Vaz (AS Roma) replaces Donyell Malen.
67' The substitution has been made. Maximo Perrone (Como) has replaced Maxence Caqueret.
66' Substitution. Lorenzo Pellegrini is replaced by Niccolo Pisilli (AS Roma).
64' RED CARD! Wesley Franca (AS Roma) makes a bad challenge and receives a second yellow card from Davide Massa. He can have an early bath.
63' Wesley Franca (AS Roma) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Davide Massa no option but to blow his whistle.
63' Lorenzo Pellegrini (AS Roma) sends in a poor cross from the corner and Jean Butez has no trouble gathering it.
63' Maxence Caqueret (Como) fouls his opponent and receives a yellow card from the referee, but he is clearly not happy with the decision.
63' Davide Massa couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Maxence Caqueret (Como) and blew his whistle.
62' AS Roma fail to score from a corner as Jean Butez (Como) leaps to collect the ball.
61' Donyell Malen (AS Roma) passes the ball into the box but an opposing player clears. AS Roma win a corner.
59' 1 - 1 Anastasios Douvikas (Como) latches on to a precise pass deep inside the box from Alex Valle, and he beats the goalkeeper with a low shot into the middle of the goal. He makes it 1:1.
58' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Como, is intercepted by one of the defenders.

57' Daniele Ghilardi (AS Roma) clearly holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows his whistle for a foul. It's a free kick to Como, but it's in no position for a direct shot on goal.
56' Gian Piero Gasperini has decided to substitute Stephan El Shaarawy and he is replaced by Devyne Rensch (AS Roma).
56' A corner kick by Como is thwarted by the well prepared Mile Svilar (AS Roma).
55' Anastasios Douvikas (Como) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety. The ball is out of play. Como will have a chance to score from a corner.
48' Wesley Franca (AS Roma) is cautioned by the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
48' Wesley Franca (AS Roma) brings an opponent down and Davide Massa interrupts the game.
46' Cesc Fabregas prepares a substitution. Marc Oliver Kempf is replaced by Anastasios Douvikas (Como).
46' It will be a substitution. Assane Diao (Como) is ready to enter the pitch as Sergi Roberto walks off.
46' The second half gets underway.
45+3' Davide Massa blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45+1' CHANCE! Nico Paz (Como) picks up a perfect pass inside the box, makes himself some space for a shot, but his effort goes just over the crossbar.
45+1' Nico Paz (Como) attempts to threaten the keeper from a long-range free kick, but his breathtaking effort flies just inches over the crossbar. It could have been a beautiful goal!
45' 2 additional min. will be played.
44' Daniele Ghilardi (AS Roma) knocks his opponent down with an over-the-top tackle. Como have a free kick.
41' Jacobo Ramon (Como) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Davide Massa has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
39' Jacobo Ramon (Como) is desperate to score a goal, but he misses the target after striking the ball well wide of the left post.
34' A crossfield pass from Martin Baturina (Como) fails to find any of his teammates.
32' Martin Baturina (Como) works the corner short.

32' Sergi Roberto (Como) tries his luck and takes a shot from inside the box. His effort on goal is blocked by a defender. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Como.
29' Ivan Smolcic (Como) plays in a hopeful cross, but it doesn't find its way to any of the attacking players.
27' The resulting corner from Martin Baturina (Como) is cleared.
24' Alex Valle (Como) beats the defender inside the box and lashes a shot towards the left side of the goal, but Mile Svilar makes a brilliant reflex save to deny him. Goalkeeping at its best!
22' A clumsy foul by Zeki Celik (AS Roma) and Davide Massa blows his whistle.
15' Nico Paz (Como) has a great chance inside the six-yard box, shoots to the bottom right corner, but Mile Svilar pulls off an exquisite save to deny him.
12' Martin Baturina (Como) swings in the corner kick, but one of the defenders leaps highest to head the ball away.

11' Lucas Da Cunha (Como) finds himself free inside the box and pulls the trigger, but his effort is brilliantly stopped by one of the defending players. The referee points to the corner flag and Como will take a corner.
7' 0 - 1 GOAL! That’s a great strike from the spot by Donyell Malen (AS Roma) low into the left of the net, giving goalkeeper Jean Butez no chance!
7' Donyell Malen (AS Roma) is going to take the penalty!
7' Davide Massa blows the whistle, Jacobo Ramon (Como) is penalised for a foul. The referee's verdict is crystal clear. A penalty is awarded to AS Roma!
4' The corner kick from Martin Baturina (Como) is headed out of the penalty area by one of the defenders.
3' Jacobo Ramon (Como) shoots inside the box, but is denied by a timely block. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Como.
3' Martin Baturina (Como) works the corner short instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
1' The first half has just begun.
AS Roma will kick-off.
Davide Massa was nominated as the referee for this game.
